Peter,

**NEW YORK CITY HAS FALLEN, DAY OF MAMDANI!!**

We are in a political race for results now. I hope the Republican Party and MAGA movement can hear me on this. The stewards of capitalism must find a financial remedy to our current situation, through innovation and a commitment to sacred honor, before the nihilism and cynicism of Socialism take root. The "free market" and "free trade" must be modified for the times.

**THIS IS THE RED ALERT!** Mamdani is only the beginning. We must remain the party and movement of the working class.

| [ **FIGHT BACK AGAINST COMMUNISM** ](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=6949158710724b569a8f5279f9666f60&_e=pIQ-JDVVRY_997vChkVA5cktXD6DLZu2zyvUBncULhfDSo9TeSaWaTFO_ftQDkfE7qdvQ4vZK2NoPrbUMLYSEQMmBtwxgmgG844XcTWEyp0_ugFamuED6Qf3cQHyBmTkZ-UWy72XIUBkS6wS4HQpTBTQMXaKe6j2dtj3RyCA0tKH8WPTKdn51W97BktqE4q4Y309t686doNa9wtPxRqTZRiK7XOSbiW8RPbmlk2-89QHxX5mS8_OWZHvGsbBRW8LhTlFMFjxVsrmXJlj0DlT2et_YdiofWsCgbcaH_2YQe_4E8JFwXus-GMcVUE_O9hYJkna4KsZAOU09Y1I2P2mIbM0Bn2ZPk8fs67opmSgZ098SV1XFStqyGdpA1c_sW1PkuXbnHB_wt-7U66YbVmrnInPe3tJlEeUeTLjbO6Xfj22akHbw5S2ty1RRmb0lpSyzvZmMdDxCjQqIe9cqDXM5Hb7Wi8D7g96XvKkbHWyG2kyfNiskheOGajMLBkoicB2uic0HX8VJVGf2BLZTWycLImdN5UVrwe9XEBlr0GLOmRSJMITIFmX0ZwI2UcE5yp7)

We need to deregulate, reduce taxes on the working class, and, most importantly, enforce our antitrust laws. The monopolization in America is out of control, and the monopolization of finance is abhorrent. The problem is that politicians can't say that and hope to win because the control of money controls our elections, most of the time. At this point, if we try to hold onto this way, we will have to do it by force, and inevitably, that will become destabilizing itself.

What has staved off communism in America, in the past, was the cultural belief in socioeconomic mobility. The social piece is all but blown as everyone believes they're the star in their own movie now. Everybody believes they're more important than they actually are. Which has created an inverse epidemic of self-doubt and self-hatred. The economic mobility piece must be restored. But artificial intelligence and socialism won't do it. People have to be motivated and incentivized to get better, at a craft, a passion, a job, a skill...

_If those things become invaluable, we will have an even bigger existential crisis. Who are we even as humankind?_

Still, we cannot continue to pretend like the game hasn't been rigged. It disappoints me that more Republicans don't listen to Steve Bannon when he says we have to find a way to spread this wealth around... Yes, we detest communists because we can see when and where they have waved their flag in history, genocide follows.

**The uncomfortable truth about America is at our core, we have already become a communist nation.** When we print money, bail out the failures of the rich, and socialize the risk, we have undermined capitalism and meritocracy. If your society is built on money and you socialize the money, you're a communist nation. We have to turn back now. This has to become the beating heart of the MAGA movement. We must hold the principle and move people toward the principle.

**Convenience will be the death of freedom.** If you trade your freedom for security, you deserve neither, and you will have neither. This is true for the security of basic necessities or food and welfare, as well as the security of a military-industrial complex and dollar empire.

_**THIS IS WHY THEY FEAR ME, on both sides of the aisle.**_

Meet Royce White:

**Born and raised in the Twin Cities, Royce White was the son of a single mother and started playing sports at the age of 5 years old. Living in various neighborhoods growing up, much of his family remained in the Rondo community, where he spent much of his time and received schooling. White excelled at basketball and recieved a scholarship to play basketball at the University of Minnesota, and later transferred to Iowa State. He would go on to make Dean's List while receiving All Big-12 first-team honors and many other basketball awards.

_After being selected 16th overall by The Houston Rockets in the NBA draft, White began to voice concerns about the NBA’s collective bargaining agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist. Eventually, his concerns became a public dispute between White and the NBA. This resulted in White demanding that the NBA, as a representative of the global corporate community, take up the responsibility of spearheading the mental health conversation – not just posturing through press statements, but through policy._

Royce then went on to win two championships in Canada before moving over to play Big 3 Basketball. White appeared at a game in a t-shirt that read “Free The Uyghurs.” After a game-winning basket, White did a post-game interview on CBS, where he called for 2 Million Uyghurs to be freed and released from concentration camps. As the season went on, White would touch on taboo topics such as Gain of Function Research, The Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Larry Hoover, Jeff Fort, Muammar Gaddafi, The Great Reset, Ivermectin, Me Too, etc.

Now, Royce White is running for Senate in Minnesota to take down the Radical Left. Republicans have not seen recent success in Minnesota, but Royce's campaign is different: a grassroots movement that's sick of the Radical Agenda pushed by Far Left Democrats Tina Smith and Ilhan Omar. Royce needs your help to pull off a fourth quarter comeback victory and FLIP Minnesota Red for Republicans.

body:
The GOP has a 53-47 majority in the Senate. THIS is how we will restore Democratic control...
#
Here's some quick math, Peter.
**Republicans currently hold a 53-47 majority in the U.S. Senate.**
**Democrats need a net gain of four seats to take control.**
That might sound like a lot. But look at the map right now:
We’re already favored to flip **North Carolina** – an open seat currently held by the GOP. **Maine** and **Ohio** are both GOP-held seats rated as TOSS-UPS.
That’s three seats we feel pretty good about.
And we haven’t even mentioned **Alaska** , **Iowa** , or **Texas** – states that are suddenly, shockingly in play for 2026.
**[FLIP THE SENATE: CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/107374?refcode=em20260808-10778&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10778%2E614464%2Eoj0O5I)**
**_Cook Political Report_ recently shifted FOUR Senate ratings in Democrats' direction, calling the likeliest outcome a one-to-three seat Democratic pickup – and noting that four seats, a full majority, is within reach.**
The environment is ripe. We’ve got strong candidates running in each of these races. Now, the only thing we need is the resources to compete in every single one of these races and MORE.
November will be here before we know it. That’s why we need your help:
**[So PLEASE, Peter, will you chip in $15 or more today to fund our fight to flip all of these seats and more across the country this year?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/107374?refcode=em20260808-10778&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10778%2E614464%2Eoj0O5I)**

clean_body: | Peter, After the sudden death of my brother, Lindsey Graham, I was appointed by Governor Henry McMaster to represent South Carolina in the United States Senate. President Trump encouraged me to consider running in the Special Election by saying, "Run, Darline, Run!" Now, with the President's "Complete and Total Endorsement," I'm running to represent South Carolina for a full term in the United States Senate. I've spent a lot of time talking and praying with my family. This was not a decision I made lightly. I know it will be difficult, but I am ready. I know what Lindsey cared about, and we shared the same conservative values. He cared deeply about the people of South Carolina. With what I learned from Lindsey and my nearly 30 years of helping people of the state find dignity through work, I am ready to take on this next challenge. It's time for me to step up for South Carolina, just like Lindsey stepped up for me when our parents died. I've learned God often calls on ordinary people to do extraordinary things in the most challenging of times. I am not Lindsey. I have my own way of doing things. But we were raised with the same values: work hard each day, trust in the Lord, remember your roots, and never forget who you work for. I did not seek this moment, Peter. But after many prayers and speaking with my family, I know I am making the right decision to run for this seat. I'll be straight with you - I am behind financially. My opponents are self-funding millionaires or have spent years building up their campaign war chests, but I'm new to politics. We have less than 3 weeks to run against people who have been at this for years. Since you were there for Lindsey, Thank you for everything you did for Lindsey over the years. I know that having people like you in his corner meant everything to him. God bless, Darline Graham P.S. It's been a difficult week. name: Raja
subject: They chanted "Death to Krishnamoorthi"
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
I need to tell you something I don't talk about enough.
Outside of my office, a group of extremists gathered and screamed what translates to "Death to Krishnamoorthi" at the top of their lungs.
A crowd of people, in America, calling for my death.
I'm an immigrant. The son of people who came to this country with nothing because they believed it was a place where you could live freely, speak freely, and serve your community without fearing for your life. A place where disagreement didn't end in threats of violence.
Sadly, this is nothing new. I have faced this before.
A sitting Republican elected official also publicly tagged the Department of Homeland Security on social media to report me as a "foreign occupier" with an "unpronounceable name" and called for the mass deportation of Indians. I have been mocked, threatened, and told in a hundred different ways that someone like me doesn't belong in American public life.
And every single time, I have made the same choice.
Keep going.
Because the moment I stop — the moment I let the hatred win — is the moment I break faith with every family that came to this country believing it was worth fighting for. Including my own.
This is the America we are living in right now. Extremists feel emboldened to threaten, intimidate, and silence the people who are trying to do the work. Hatred has been given permission to operate in the open. The machinery of government is being used to make certain communities feel like they don't belong.
Equal Opportunity Now exists because we need leaders who have faced this kind of hatred and didn't flinch . Who know what it costs to keep going and choose to keep going anyway. Who will stand up — not just for themselves, but for every family that is being targeted, threatened, and told they don't belong.
Those leaders are out there. And they need our support right now.
Will you chip in $10, $20, or $50 to Equal Opportunity Now today to help us elect leaders who won't be intimidated — no matter what they face? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
DONATE TODAY! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/eon-email]
They can scream all they want.
We are not slowing down.
— Raja Krishnamoorthi

I’m asking you to chip in $3 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?] to help me defend one of the most competitive House seats in the country.
No, seriously. Just $3.
That’s not a typo.
I’m Marie Gluesenkamp Perez, and ever since I first won this seat in 2022, Republicans have been desperate to win it back.
They know this is one of the most competitive seats in the country – that’s why national election analysts just moved this race to "Toss-up."
They also know control of the House hinges on the outcome of our race.
That’s why the GOP and Elon Musk are preparing to spend millions on this race.
But here's the thing: I've never had billionaire donors or Washington insiders powering my campaigns. I’ve had families, workers, and small business owners – folks who just want to believe in a better future.
I’m backed by working people chipping in what they can because they want someone in Congress who understands the challenges they're facing.
That's why your $3 matters.
* $3 helps us organize communities across Southwest Washington.
* $3 helps us reach independent and working-class voters who decide elections here.
* $3 helps us fight back against the flood of outside spending and attack ads that are already on the way.
And if enough people step up, even with just a few dollars, we'll have what it takes to win one of the closest races in the country.
So I'm asking: Can you chip in $3 right now to help us defend this seat and keep fighting for working families? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mgpvf-dsg-email?]

body:
This is what we're up against
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260808-3133)
Peter,
You've heard a lot about me and my primary opponents these past few weeks. Today, I want to talk about the fight that matters most: this November.
On January 6, 2021, Congressman Tom Tiffany voted to throw out Arizona and Pennsylvania's electoral votes for president. He told reporters that day that he would have voted to reject Wisconsin's results too, if given the chance. He was the only member of Wisconsin's congressional delegation to sign onto a lawsuit trying to overturn the election results in four swing states, including ours.
[](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260808.OsbbaN&refcode=em20260808-3133&t=1&akid=3133%2E105371%2EESYSQ4)_"I would have voted to not accept Wisconsin's results" — Tom Tiffany._
_Source: Remarks to reporters, Jan. 6, 2021 — the same day he voted to reject AZ & PA electors_
**Here's why that matters beyond 2020:** _U _nder_ Wisconsin law, the governor personally signs the certificate that certifies our state's electors for president._ The person elected governor this November will hold that pen heading into 2028.
I'm not going to sit back and breathe easy on August 11th, no matter what happens. Whether or not I'm the nominee, Wisconsin faces a race this fall against a man who's already told us he'd throw out our votes if he could.
[We're going to need a full war chest starting day one of the general election. A contribution of $10, $25, or whatever you can give today helps us make sure every Wisconsinite knows exactly who Tom Tiffany is before they vote.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260808.OsbbaN&refcode=em20260808-3133&t=2&akid=3133%2E105371%2EESYSQ4)

With gratitude,
Fran

He walked away from his thriving Hollywood career, but he later built a happy life with another former child star, as detailed in _[Whatever Happened To...](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MFuszAQBOCnMbeg9ZofzMGHX6pyaJteK_WCbLwGR8aOyBKUPn1FX6HXGenTaD4vw8XGFPP0YRcyHMqQab8nYqZ1CORptWkqD1rzQpnDlj15tw0I2J5An6AfvI3pOTSVN4EISVVkZKdb7AB1W83mnwwjeRjBgWqcJuWcc73zre9A9h6raA4NNPQSpERVq87J0UGrR2y0BRQNkI9c1vpaYuaZQnoek-qxLFUyM_PtLtR_gWeB533f62fZeHN09EdieZyFOj-Eeum-3t6_eYLXq65W4297TCne2040MC02pl-S__TDw-BPAAAA__-GgnFn)_ In case you missed it, this week on _The Flyover Podcast_ , Amy uncovered five Amazon Prime benefits hiding in plain sight. One could save the average driver nearly $70 a year, while another may even beat your insurance copay. Amy explained how to activate all five, so before you place your next order, find out what you may already be paying for but never using. ## Senate Funds Government through Midterms
The Senate voted early on Saturday to [fund the federal government until Dec. 11,](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOqzAURL_G7oiuLw6YwsVr6PLaLZHBY_DKmAicRPn7FbvFfsC2M9LRnPm4DTcXU8zzf7fClrANGa8joRTsQ4DH7tK8PbHnFbmER_bw42Ng4qYiU1E3eBfTe9DS2wAwagmrWtNwS2waudi6AxTc6K-d0QET2F_DNZDzup3GVstoTxoZ6hQpxfWlbkc1jdSYibVxxEITfCzbfvncYi4LQnqfky7Ttspkl1Luh6j_Ce4F92XBElM6O8H9sq04hQT3B7IrENw3pAxRV_0E1a9dderFPFdjTElwL3fr76-YUjyaVmiaVxe_wbL86amn5a8AAAD__6sRfcs) averting another government shutdown before the midterm elections. Lawmakers headed to summer recess [without taking up the SAVE America Act](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD3u4yAQxU9jd47GA8a4oNgmXbbd0hozQ8IK4whIotx-5b3Cv3x60vv4_bmtN4op5vtv2sW1cKxZPjVJa1LWICyF0v14S8m75BZemYW314qAZgA7wLIyxfRddc8uiKCoXtw4W4MzoDX9wymwFqegyPOivA0bayBvPHktDIB9dGcaWFhGGEdUFzVvo9_AWI_aEmCnQTi2o1z-HjG3h4T0PSdd_LH3yT1ae9ZO_erw2uGVnueB0zpFadEn6fBa6S0D7VKip4F8G6pkajIU8VLrYJiRLVgtotFMatO8zYvnyUw8TqD74vj5iSnFauZOw32nmP73tx9Bezv8FwAA__8My3-A), President Trump's proof-of-citizenship voting bill. The Senate could try to approve parts of the bill as part of a GOP package to fund the Iran war in September. **Whatever Happened To... Macaulay Culkin?** He became one of the most famous children in the world at 10 years old. Four years later, Macaulay Culkin did something Hollywood rarely allows: He walked away. [_Home Alone_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0M1q6zAUBOCnkXcxx0e6srLQ4kIa2kUK7aZLoZ-jWEWWgiPH5O2L-wrdzsDHMF8Xc7Epp3J9tzPpFqsptN0ztUaLiRRosflaH7SUmUqLawkU3GoQUB5AHeBogk35aUQXdCRC4h3pYVQSR0Alu0lLG2UUo4cAikvnyIroI0VAOQI__uuS3jVQcBxgGJD3fHSDdyCVR6EsIBNAIbW69N81lTZRzM99Uu_r3GU9tXa7M_6f4Znhedu2_lnXtjra-z2xzU-Mnx-Mn_Ln6U0Or5cP8dItOty2lHO6y5EJuM425V-y_emHh8afAAAA__8UmHCV) opened in November 1990 and turned Culkin into a global star almost overnight. _My Girl_ , _Home Alone 2_ , _The Good Son,_ and _Richie Rich_ followed, but behind the success was a childhood consumed by work and a bitter dispute between his parents over custody and control of his fortune. _" I quit for nearly a decade,"_ Culkin said during a recent [interview](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0MFuszAQBOCnMbeg9ZofzMGHX6pyaJteK_WCbLwGR8aOyBKUPn1FX6HXGenTaD4vw8XGFPP0YRcyHMqQab8nYqZ1CORptWkqD1rzQpnDlj15tw0I2J5An6AfvI3pOTSVN4EISVVkZKdb7AB1W83mnwwjeRjBgWqcJuWcc73zre9A9h6raA4NNPQSpERVq87J0UGrR2y0BRQNkI9c1vpaYuaZQnoek-qxLFUyM_PtLtR_gWeB533f62fZeHN09EdieZyFOj-Eeum-3t6_eYLXq65W4297TCne2040MC02pl-S__TDw-BPAAAA__-GgnFn). He went to high school and finally learned how to be a teenager. When he returned, it was entirely on his terms. He took unusual independent roles, formed a Velvet Underground parody band devoted to pizza, and launched the satirical website Bunny Ears. He still describes himself as "technically retired" between projects, emerging only when something genuinely interests him. The more meaningful comeback happened away from the cameras. Culkin reconnected with fellow former child star Brenda Song while filming _Changeland_ in Thailand in 2017.
